title: How to Assess a Corporate Event Catering Proposal
body_markdown:
Assess a corporate event proposal against the agenda, venue and approval process. Check menu quantities, service responsibilities, access and the items included in the written scope.

For the service options, explore [corporate catering in Dubai](/corporate). Use this guide to prepare the details for your enquiry.

## About this guide

This guide is published by myCHEF, a provider of private chef and catering services. It compares service formats and practical selection criteria. Individual providers should be assessed through their current proposals, relevant documentation and suitability for your occasion.

## Choose a format around the agenda

Passed canapés help guests move through a reception. A buffet provides choice for a larger group, while a plated dinner gives a formal sequence that can be timed around speeches. Ask how staffing and service points will support the expected guest flow.

## Coordinate with the venue and planner

Confirm loading, kitchen access, equipment, power and the available setup window. Identify the person responsible for the running order and agree how changes are communicated. Catering, staging, entertainment and audiovisual support should have clear owners.

## Request an approval-ready proposal

The quote should identify food, staff, equipment, transport, service hours and VAT. The complete event price depends on the confirmed brief.

## Questions to ask before confirming

Request a written menu and scope, confirm the guest count and service hours, and check which staff, equipment and extras are included. Share dietary requirements before approving the menu. Review the payment schedule, change deadlines and cancellation terms, and identify the contact who will coordinate the booking.

## Use your completed brief

If corporate event catering suits your plans, explore the service details and published options below. Share your date, Dubai location, guest count and preferences so the team can assess availability and prepare a tailored proposal. The written booking confirms the final menu, responsibilities and price.

[Explore corporate event catering](/corporate-event-catering-dubai) · [Request a proposal](/inquiry)
